lead_html: Owner, by card 2026-10-22 (Joints: fittings art and pipe meets tank → Draw fittings + pipe riser): the 12 joint fitting pictures, one Flange, Coupler and Saddle per look, in that look's own pipe colours. Sizes from the joints study (D4): flange collar about 0.13 cell, union coupler 0.12, hose saddle 0.24, against a pipe of 0.10. Pick a column per row, or note what to change. The REFERENCE picture beside each row shows the piece on its pipe as the game places it. Nothing is installed and joinFittings stays off until you have picked. Item PIPE_TANK_JOIN_FIX_SLIPS_UNDER_SKID; study Transient/pile_2026-10-22/joints_study.md.
